title.small: Share things with the people you trust.

problem.big:
Tools, ladders and books are lent
by text message. No record,
nobody sure who has what,
no way to know who to trust.
problem.small: Lendger keeps the record, privately, in your circle.

end.small:
Self-hostable. Your data stays yours.
Only members can read what you share: not even the server can.
Free for personal and community use. No tracking.
